name: ai-threejs-studio
description: AI Three.js Studio — generate explorable 3D worlds from a single sentence.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @ai-three-studio/shared" "npm run dev -w @ai-three-studio/server" "npm run dev -w @ai-three-studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ai-three-studio/server && npm run build -w @ai-three-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ai-three-studio/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-three-studio/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @ai-three-studio/server
